dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 22, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
"MLB Recap: Home Runs Fly as Tigers and Blue Jays Take Down Yankees and Astros"

In a thrilling day of baseball, the Detroit Tigers pulled off a 3-5 win over the New York Yankees, thanks in part to Amed Rosario's seventh home run of the season. Rosario's fly ball to right center field brought in two runs, but the Tigers ultimately took the lead. Meanwhile, Framber Valdez dominated on the mound, striking out eight and allowing just one earned run over six innings.

In other action, the Kansas City Royals edged the Tampa Bay Rays 2-1, with Michael Wacha pitching a strong 7.0 innings, striking out five and allowing just one earned run. Brayan Rocchio hit a go-ahead home run in the 9th inning to seal the win for the White Sox in a 5-6 game against the Guardians.

The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Houston Astros 2-4, with Kazuma Okamoto hitting a home run and driving in a run. The Milwaukee Brewers outlasted the Cincinnati Reds 2-1, with Brandon Woodruff pitching a shutout inning and striking out ten.

The Colorado Rockies edged the Boston Red Sox 2-3, with Jake Bennett pitching a gem, striking out nine and allowing no earned runs. The Baltimore Orioles routed the Los Angeles Angels 6-1, with Kyle Bradish pitching a complete game shutout, striking out nine and allowing no earned runs.

The St. Louis Cardinals took down the Arizona Diamondbacks 2-3, with Andre Pallante earning the win in relief. The San Diego Padres edged the Atlanta Braves 0-1, with Michael King pitching a complete game shutout, striking out five and allowing no earned runs.
